selection_basis: candidate was discovered by repository/code metadata search before its CSV content was opened
repository code explicitly declares direct anonymous collection from the IBKR shortstock FTP
the exact CSV path has one observed Git commit and an exact Git blob SHA
file size is large enough to warrant structural prequalification but size is not an admission criterion
stage_1_allowed: fetch the exact public Git blob at the frozen commit
compute SHA-256 and byte length over the exact file bytes
decode CSV strictly enough to identify header and row count
record exact header names and order
identify temporal columns only by predeclared case-insensitive names: TIMESTAMP, DATETIME, DATE, FETCHED_AT, OBSERVED_AT, BOF_TIMESTAMP, TIME
parse values only from identified temporal columns to derive earliest/latest timestamp, distinct dates and observed calendar months
record whether predeclared canonical economic field names SYM, CON, ISIN, FEERATE, REBATERATE and AVAILABLE are present, without emitting their row values
record duplicate-row count only if computable without selecting on economic magnitude
record whether every parsed row has a temporal value
stage_1_forbidden: emit or summarize any FEERATE, REBATERATE or AVAILABLE values
rank/select rows, symbols, dates or months by economic values
infer missing availability or fee values
treat a transformed CSV as raw IBKR bytes
treat repository provenance declarations as sufficient authenticity without later overlap authentication
use credentials, API keys or account login
prequalification_pass_requires: at least one parseable temporal column exists
at least one observation month falls within the frozen missing-month window 2024-07 through 2026-08
if_pass_next_gate: Freeze a transformed-carrier authentication protocol before comparing selected overlapping observations to direct IBKR/public community snapshots or using any economic field.
